note: Towns now remember how they feel about you: every town and village tracks a standing from Ally down to Scowls, and the tier shows in villager dialogue and when you examine someone. Hitting a villager lowers their town standing, killing one drops it hard, and finishing a quest for a town raises it. Guards start wary of you while priests and children start welcoming, so the same standing can read differently from person to person. Standing is separate from bounty: paying a fine or serving jail clears what you owe, but it does not repair what a town thinks of you. No prices, dialogue, or guard behavior change with standing yet — the tier is display only for now.
